verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Iosefatu faatasi ma ona tama, ua tanu foi o ia faatasi ma ona tama i le aai a Tavita. Ona soloai ane ai lea o Ioramo lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.sm: Sa ia te ia ona uso, o atalii o Iosefatu, o Asaraia, ma leielu, ma Sakaria, ma Asaraio, ma Mekaeli, ma Sefatiao; o atalii uma ia o Iosefatu le tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.sm: Na foaiina atu e lo latou tama ia te i latou mea alofa e tele, o ario, ma auro, ma oloa táua, atoa ma aai nofo ‘olo i Iuta; a o le malo na ia tuuina ia Ioramo, aua o ia o le ulumatua.

verses.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua maua e Ioramo le malo o lona tama, ona faamalosi ai lea, ma na fasioti i ona uso uma i le pelu, atoa ma nisi alii sili o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: E tolu sefulu ma le lua o tausaga O Ioramo ina o fai o ia ma tupu; ua fai foi o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema i tausaga e valu.

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua ia savali i le ala o tupu o Isaraelu, e pei ona faia e le aiga o Aapo; aua ua fai mana ava le afafine o Aapo; ua fai amio leaga o ia i luma o le ALII.

verses.en: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.sm: A e lei finagalo le ALII ona faaumatia le aiga o Tavita, ona o le feagaiga na osia ma Tavita, faapei ona fetalai mai o ia, e tuuina mai le lamepa ia te ia ma ana fanau i aso uma.

verses.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
verses.sm: O lana nofoaiga na foua ai Iuta e Etoma, ua latou faanofo foi so latou lava tupu.

verses.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o Ioramo, ma alii sili ua ia te ia, atoa ma ana kariota uma faatasi ma ia; ona tulai lea o ia i le po, ma na fasi ia Etoma na sio ia te ia, atoa ma alii o kariota.

verses.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
verses.sm: A ua foua Iuta e Etoma, ua oo lava i ona po nei. O ia ona po na foua ai o ia e Lipena; aua na tuua e ia o le ALII le Atua o ona tama.

verses.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o mea maualuluga i mauga o Iuta, ma faatupu le faitaaga i e nonofo i Ierusalema, ma na tosina ai Iuta.

verses.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.sm: Ua au mai le tusi ia te ia mai ia Elia le perofeta, ua faapea mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII le Atua o Tavita lou tama, Ua e le savali i ala o Iosefatu lou tama, ma ala o Asa le tupu o Tuta,

verses.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
verses.sm: a ua e savali i le ala o tupuo Isaraelu, ma ua e faatupuina le faitaaga ia Iuta, ma e o nonofo i Ierusalema, e pei o faitaaga o le aiga o Aapo, ma ua e fasiotia foi ou uso o le aiga o lou tama, o e ua sili ona lelei ia te oe;

verses.en: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.sm: faauta, o le mea lea e faaoo ai e le ALII le malaia tele i lou nuu, ma lau fanau, ma au ava, ma au oloa uma;

verses.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.sm: o oe foi e ia te oe le ta“ tele, o le mai e tupu i lou manava, seia pau i fafo lou gaau ona o le taў i lea aso ma lea aso.

verses.en: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.sm: Ua faaoso foi e le ALII ia Filisitia, ma Arapi, o e ua latalata ane i Kusa, e tau ma Ioramo.

verses.en: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.sm: Ona latou o ae lea i Iuta, ma osofaiina ai, ma latou ave oloa uma na maua i le fale o le tupu, o ona atalii foi, ma ana ava, na le toe ia te ia se atalii, ua na o Ioasasa le aupito itiiti i ona atalii.

verses.en: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.sm: Ua ma656 vae ja mea uma, ona taja lea o ia e le Aw: i le ta“ i lona manava e le mafaamaloloina.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.sm: Ua oo ina mavae O aso e tele, va atoa tausaga e lua, ona pati lea i fafo o lona gaau ona o lona maʻi; ona oti ai lea o ia i maʻi leaga. Ua le muina le afi mo 1a e lona nuu, e pei ona muina o afi mo ona tama.

verses.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.sm: E tolu sefulu ma le lua ona tausaga ina o fai o ia ma tupu, na fai foi o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema i tausaga e valu. Ua alu o ia e leai se tausaafi ia te ia. Ua tanu foi o ia i le aai a Tavita, a e le o i tuugamau o tupu.
